exposure: lack of pain relief during labour
Participation in the 'Ready for Child program'
uncertain or weak attachment to the newborn child
none or minor breastfeeding in the early postpartum period
low attendance of the midwife in the delivery room
poor or fair self-rated mental health
finding: A short general antenatal program in pregnancy did not significantly reduce the risk of postpartum depression at six weeks after birth, but several risk factors during birth and the early postpartum period were identified.
mod_finding: Unscheduled cesarean section was associated with an increased risk of postpartum depression.
